title: tdh.util.channelstripSt~
description: `tdh.util.channelstripSt~` emulates an inline mixer channel strip for stereo input, providing VU metering, panning across the stereo image, and gain control in either linear amplitude (0–1) or dBFS (−20 to +6). It outputs the processed left and right signals, and its volume can also be controlled by a signal; the module requires the ELSE and CYCLONE libraries.
